title: Topology of isometric classes and flows of geometric structures
summary: We revisit flows of tensorial $H$-structures for closed and connected Lie subgroups $H\leqslant\mathrm{SO}(n)$, focusing on the topology of isometric classes. We prove that the natural map assigning to an $H$-structure its induced Riemannian metric is surjective and satisfies a parametric homotopy lifting property. Since the space of Riemannian metrics is contractible, the full space of $H$-structures is homotopy equivalent to any fixed isometric class.
